title: Customer Sales Advisor
description:
Full job description

Job Title: Trainee Insurance Advisor Full Training Provided (No Experience Needed!)

Location: Bournemouth (Office-based)

Salary: £27,000 £33,000 (Depending on experience/growth potential)

Hours: Monday Friday, 08 00 (Plus 1 Saturday morning per month/WFH)

Kickstart Your Career No Experience Needed!

Stuck in retail, hospitality, or sales, and looking for an office-based career with real progression and professional qualifications?

We are a close-knit, high-energy independent insurance brokerage in Taunton looking for ambitious, people-focused individuals to join our team. We don t expect you to know anything about insurance we care about your personality, drive, and communication skills, and we ll teach you the rest.

What s in It for You?
- Earn While You Learn: A competitive starting salary of £27,000 £33,000, with clear milestones for pay increases.
- Fully Funded Professional Qualifications: We pay for you to gain your Cert CII (Chartered Insurance Institute) professional credentials, boosting your market value.
- Real Career Progression: This isn't just a phone job. You ll get a 360-degree understanding of personal lines, commercial insurance, and client management.
- Solid Work-Life Balance: Standard Monday to Friday hours (with just one Saturday shift a month) so you still have your weekends.
- Great Team Culture: Work in a supportive, friendly environment where your wins are actually celebrated (no corporate micromanagement here).

What You ll Be Doing:
- Talking to clients every day, building genuine rapport, and finding the right insurance policies to protect what matters to them.
- Guiding customers through quotes, renewals, and policy updates over the phone and via email.
- Keeping accurate digital records and managing client portfolios with attention to detail.
- Collaborating with the team to hit collective milestones and earn bonus/incentive rewards.

About You:
- People Person: You re confident, chatty, and naturally good at building trust with anyone.
- Ambitious & Driven: You want a long-term professional career path, not just a stepping-stone job.
- Organised & Tech-Savvy: Comfortable navigating computer systems and keeping track of details.
- Ready to Learn: Willing to study for professional qualifications (good GCSEs, including Maths, are helpful here!).

Ready to start your next chapter? Hit 'Apply Now' and let s chat.

Cowell Recruitment Ltd is an equal opportunities recruitment agency. Only candidates with the Right to Work (RTW) in the UK can be considered.

title: Food Service Sales Representative
description:
Food Service Sales Representative

Permanent Salary up to 40,000 DOE

Location: Blandford Forum DT11 7 SX

Help bring luxury confectionery to the food service and hospitality industry.

Our client is a leading UK distributor of premium chocolates and confectionery, is looking for an experienced and driven Food Service Sales Representative to join its growing team.

Following significant growth within the food service division and increasing demand for the products, we are looking for a motivated sales professional to develop new business opportunities and build lasting customer relationships across the sector.

The Role

Reporting to the Head of Food Service, you will play a key role in expanding our presence across the food service and hospitality market.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Identifying, developing and securing new customer accounts within your agreed territory.
- Managing and growing relationships with existing customers.
- Building new business opportunities across hotels, restaurants, event companies, cruise lines, charities, corporate organisations and wholesalers.
- Promoting the company's premium chocolate and confectionery range.
- Providing product knowledge, advice and tailored solutions to customers.
- Negotiating commercial opportunities and driving sales growth.
- Working closely with the Head of Food Service to achieve sales targets and business objectives.

About You

We are looking for someone who is commercially minded, proactive and passionate about sales and customer relationships.

Ideally, you will have:
- Previous experience in a Sales Representative or Business Development role within the food service, hospitality or catering industry.
- An established network of contacts within the hospitality and food service sectors.
- Excellent communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
- A proven ability to identify new business opportunities and win new customers.
- A self-motivated and organised approach, with the ability to work independently.
- A passion for premium products and delivering exceptional customer service.
- A full UK driving licence.

What's on Offer?
- Permanent position.
- Salary up to 40,000 DOE.
- Opportunity to develop and grow within an expanding business.
- The chance to represent a premium portfolio of luxury chocolate and confectionery brands.

Interested?

If you have a background in food service sales and are looking for an opportunity to develop new business and build strong customer relationships, we would love to hear from you.

title: Insurance Sales Advisor - Switch
description:
£35,000 basic salary + uncapped commission
Realistic OTE £70,000-£100,000+
High-quality inbound opportunities - no cold calling

Are you an experienced Private Medical Insurance adviser with a background in policy switching, renewals or retention?

Usay Compare is expanding its specialist PMI switch capability and is looking for experienced advisers who can review existing cover, navigate switch underwriting and help customers make informed decisions about moving insurer.

The Opportunity

You'll speak with customers who already hold Private Medical Insurance and are considering their options, often following a renewal increase or change in circumstances.

Using a consultative fact-find, you'll review their existing policy, medical underwriting position, claims history and priorities before comparing suitable alternatives from across our insurer panel.

This is about more than price. You'll help customers understand the implications of switching, including differences in underwriting, exclusions, benefits, hospital access, excesses and policy terms.

What You'll Do
- Advise existing PMI policyholders considering switching insurer.
- Review current cover, renewal premiums, claims history and customer objectives.
- Complete detailed fact-finds and assess whether switching is appropriate.
- Work with switch underwriting arrangements, including Continued Personal Medical Exclusions and continued moratorium terms where available.
- Compare insurers and key policy benefits to make clear, suitable recommendations.
- Manage applications from initial enquiry through to policy inception.
- Deliver strong customer outcomes while achieving quality, compliance and sales targets.

About You

You'll ideally have:
- Previous advised sales experience within UK individual Private Medical Insurance.
- Practical experience of insurer-to-insurer PMI switches.
- A sound understanding of switch underwriting, continuity of cover, CPME, moratorium and full medical underwriting.
- Experience reviewing claims, exclusions and existing policy terms before making recommendations.
- Strong knowledge of individual PMI products and insurer propositions.
- Excellent consultative questioning and objection-handling skills.
- A proven record against sales, quality and compliance measures.
- A customer-focused approach, resilience and motivation to maximise your earning potential.

Renewals or retention experience is particularly relevant where you have reviewed alternative insurers and completed advised switch business.

Why Join Us?

Alongside a £35,000 basic salary and uncapped commission with realistic OTE of £70,000-£100,000+, you'll benefit from:
- High-quality inbound customer opportunities with no cold calling.
- An established insurer panel and strong lead flow.
- Structured induction and ongoing product, underwriting and compliance development.
- Career progression opportunities.
- Life Assurance at four times basic salary.
- Group Income Protection.
- Pension with a 6% employer contribution.
- 26 days' holiday plus bank holidays.
- Performance incentives, a paid volunteering day and additional lifestyle benefits.

Apply Now

If you're an experienced Private Medical Insurance professional with switch, renewal or retention expertise, we'd love to hear from you.

Join Usay Compare and play an important role in growing our specialist switch proposition while helping customers make informed decisions about their healthcare cover.

Usay Compare, part of Everywhen, is an equal opportunities employer committed to creating an inclusive working environment where everyone can reach their full potential.

Successful applicants will be subject to relevant pre-employment checks, including verification of recent employment, address and credit history, together with a standard criminal-record check.

title: Account Executive
description:
Account Executive Health, Beauty & Household Products

B2 B Account Management National Accounts Product & Project Management

Location: Christchurch
Working pattern: Hybrid 2 days in the office, 3 days working from home after the initial settling-in period

About the Business

Join a growing consumer products business supplying some of the UK's biggest retailers and fashion-led brands.

This Account Executive role in Christchurch is an excellent opportunity to develop a career across account management, national accounts, product development, project management and commercial operations, working with major retail customers across the health, beauty and household sectors.

You'll gain exposure to the full product and account lifecycle, from market research and product samples through to customer presentations, product listings and finished products on retail shelves.

About the Role

As an Account Executive, you'll support major retail accounts while developing your own areas of responsibility over time.

The role combines B2 B account management, customer relationship management, project coordination, product development and commercial analysis. It's a varied position with plenty of responsibility, making it ideal for someone looking to build a strong foundation in a commercial career.

Initially, you'll gain experience across market research, administration, product samples and account support, before gradually taking ownership of your own projects and areas within a major retail account.

You'll work closely with customers and internal teams across product, operations, commercial and technical, as well as colleagues and suppliers in the Far East.

Key Responsibilities as an Account Executive:
- Support the management and development of major retail and national accounts
- Build strong relationships with customers and develop a good understanding of their business, strategy and requirements
- Identify opportunities to support account growth, product development and new product listings
- Attend regular customer meetings, presenting new products and supporting commercial discussions
- Coordinate customer and product projects from initial concept through to completion
- Work collaboratively with product, operations, commercial and technical teams
- Liaise with international colleagues and suppliers, including teams in the Far East
- Conduct market research and monitor retail and consumer trends
- Manage product samples and support the product development process
- Monitor sales performance and account activity on a weekly basis
- Prepare and provide regular sales reports and commercial information

About You

We're looking for a commercially minded, organised and relationship-focused individual who is keen to develop a career in account management and consumer products.

You may already have experience as an:

Account Executive, Account Manager, Sales Executive, Sales Coordinator. Retail Store Manager, Buyer or Buying Assistant, Product Coordinator, Product Executive, Project Coordinator, Commercial Executive

Experience within retail, FMCG, consumer goods, health & beauty, household products or a product-led business would be beneficial, but is not essential.

You'll ideally have:
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills
- A commercial mindset and an interest in sales and account performance
- Confidence communicating with customers and internal stakeholders

Experience working with major retailers or national accounts would be advantageous, but we're also open to candidates with transferable experience and the right commercial mindset.

Why Join?
- Build a career across account management, product and project management
- Work with some of the UK's leading retail and fashion-led brands
- Gain exposure to national accounts and major retail customers
- Take ownership of your own projects and areas of responsibility
- Work closely with product, commercial, operations and technical teams
- See projects through from initial concept to finished products in retail
- Strong learning, development and career progression opportunities
- Hybrid working with 3 days from home
- Join a collaborative team where ideas and new approaches are encouraged

Benefits
- Annual company bonus and salary reviews
- 25 days' holiday, increasing to 27 days after 3 years and 30 days after 5 years and ability to purchase additional holiday
- Free parking on Christchurch Quay
- Medical cash plan and access to mental health support
- Career progression opportunities
- Enhanced maternity and paternity leave
- Cycle to Work scheme

Apply Now

If you're currently working in account management, sales, retail, buying, product or project coordination and are looking for your next opportunity within a growing consumer products business, we'd love to hear from you.

This is a great opportunity to develop your commercial experience while working with major retail accounts and well-known consumer products.

If you are interested in this National Account Executive position, please apply now. Alternatively, for more information, please call us and ask for Laura. She has worked for the client for over 8 years, and can give you all the ins and outs of the business and the role.

title: Account Manager
description:
ACCOUNT MANAGER JOB SUMMARY:

On behalf of a Poole based organisation, we are looking for an experienced Account Manager, Technical Sales or Business Development professional, with a background in engineering, manufacturing or industrial distribution.

The ideal Account Manager will be commercially astute, with proven experience of managing a diverse portfolio of customers, building relationships, identifying growth opportunities and increasing sales revenue and profitability.

This is a proactive Account Management role focused on growing existing customer accounts, as well as bringing on new business through inbound sales conversions, and your own proactive business development outreach.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE ACCOUNT MANAGER:
- Manage and develop an existing portfolio of customers, largely within engineering and industrial sectors.
- Work closely with your customers to understand their requirements, uncover new opportunities and deliver tailored product solutions.
- Build strong relationships internally, and working cross functionally with purchasing, engineering, operations and supply chain
- Identify opportunities to increase sales, market share and profitability within existing accounts
- Generate and follow up quotations, driving opportunities through to order completion
- Whilst this is an office-based position, you will conduct account reviews, do site / customer visits (as required) and undertake growth planning activities
- Work closely with internal sales, technical support and operations teams to ensure that the order process and after sales support is managed effectively
- Maintain accurate CRM records, sales forecasts and opportunity pipelines
- Support the development of warm leads, referrals and selected new business opportunities

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE:

Our client is looking for an Account Manager / Business Development / Sales person with a minimum of years' experience in a similar Account Management, Technical Sales, Internal Sales or Business Development role.
- A background within engineering, manufacturing, industrial product distribution, mechanical, electrical or technical sales is essential.
- Proven experience of growing customer accounts and managing the full sales cycle
- Strong commercial awareness and relationship-building skills
- Comfortable discussing technical products and customer applications
- Experience using CRM systems and the ability to learn new processes quickly
- Excellent communication, organisation and negotiation skills
- Self-motivated with a proactive and results-driven approach.
- An engineering qualification would be advantageous, but not essential as product training will be ongoing.

THE PACKAGE:

Along with an attractive salary and benefits package, this role offers long term opportunity for progression, within a growth focused organisation.
- Basic salary up to £45k
- Bonus / commission structure in place
- Lovely offices, with free parking on site
- Pension scheme with enhanced employer contribution
- Companywide social events
- Early finish on a Friday, offering a better work life balance

For more information about this exciting opportunity, or to apply, please contact Joy Bruce at Collaborate Recruitment.
